name: remove configuration and process-id lifecycle files
definition: Delete the service config and PID files after data handling.
failure_mode: Any leftover lifecycle file fails the deletion check.

name: repair a broken python environment where pip cannot install packages
definition: Diagnose why pip is missing or non-functional in a python interpreter and restore a working package installer into that environment.
failure_mode: Pip module not importable or the broken install is not repaired.
